title: QBit Vault identity (qbitdev brand)
brief: QBit Vault as a product of the user's qbitdev brand: black, blue and green, the Q with a blue-to-green gradient inside atom orbits, a light lowercase wordmark. Mark, palette (measured from the user's logo), type, README banner and the terminal header for the TUI.

artboards.title: Atom keyhole
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to the qbitdev logo (same Q, same orbits) with a keyhole in the counter; strongest family resemblance, the keyhole is small at favicon sizes. Intended typefaces: Sora Light for the wordmark, Inter for text, JetBrains Mono.

artboards.title: Hex seal
artboards.tradeoff: The hoodie's hexagon badge as a vault seal; crisp at 16 px and easy to draw in the terminal; a little more geometric and less 'atomic' than the master logo. Intended typefaces: Sora Light, Inter, JetBrains Mono.

artboards.title: Orbit lock
artboards.tradeoff: An orbit becomes a padlock shackle over the Q: reads as 'lock' to anyone, not only developers; the taller shape fits square slots less well. Intended typefaces: Sora Light, Inter, JetBrains Mono.
